title: LLM-AS-AN-INTERVIEWER: Beyond Static Testing Through Dynamic LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Examining the linear correlation between the length of the responses (measured in tokens) and the evaluation scores assigned by the LLM across different stages of the interaction to see if longer answers are favored.
Analyzing whether an LLM assigns higher scores to its own generated responses compared to responses from other models when acting as the evaluator (interviewer).
